Thanks Jared — and great to meet you on the demo.

Quick note on Redwood procurement: our default is to require a PO for any vendor provisioning that touches production or is billed via subscription. That said, we do run a documented temporary "invoice-only" path for short pilots with clear guardrails. To evaluate TileBridge for that path we need the following from your side:

- Signed SOW or engagement letter (we can accept the attached v1 if signed)
- Scope limited to one team / single seat and a firm end date (you indicated 30 days)
- Certificate of insurance (cyber liability) or equivalent evidence
- Point of contact for billing + a remittance email/address

If you can provide those, procurement-owned exception (SUP-4231) can be approved for a finite window. Marissa, can you flag any finance constraints here? Dylan, please note for onboarding checklist if we proceed.

I can issue a 60-day temporary exception addendum template to TileBridge that requires a PO on conversion to a subscription or any renewal. I'll also add the HubSpot deal and open the SUP ticket.

Related: https://hubspot.redwood.ai/deals/TB-EXP-0012
